content.text: The notes app is built, and all 12 requirements work at 1280px and 375px wide. Unit tests, browser tests and the production build all pass. I haven't committed anything. Run it with `npm run dev` (http://localhost:5203). - **Libraries:** it uses `marked` to render Markdown and `DOMPurify` to sanitize the output, both added with npm. - **Raw HTML:** it is shown as plain text rather than rendered, and the sanitizer is a second layer behind that. - **Layout:** the editor and preview sit side by side from 1024px up. Below that they stack, and on mobile the sidebar and the editor are separate screens with a "← Notes" back button. - **Checkbox limit:** the preview checkbox is matched to the Nth `- [ ]` line in the source, skipping fenced code blocks. A checkbox-looking line inside an indented (non-fenced) code block would throw that count off. I didn't test that case. - **Reload on a fresh load:** the first load starts with a "Welcome" note. ## What I tested and how - **Logic, 13 unit tests (Vitest, `npm test`):** - sort order (pinned first, then newest) - case-insensitive search across titles and contents - match highlighting and snippets - word count - checkbox toggling, including skipping fenced code and out-of-range indexes - saving and loading, including corrupt data and write failure - Markdown rendering, including script tags, ``, `javascript:` links and raw `` all being neutralized - **Browser, 16 tests (Playwright driving real Chrome, `npx playwright test`):** the same 8 scenarios at 1280px and 375px. - **Layout:** side by side on desktop, stacked on mobile, with no horizontal scroll. - **Rendering:** headings, bold, italic, lists, links, code blocks and checkbox lists. Clicking preview checkboxes updates the source both ways. - **Safety:** a `
